title: abrahamaiproject-bit/geocoder-cache
body:
# geocoder-cache

Redis-backed cache in front of the third-party geocoding API, used by **Project Atlas** to cut routing latency.

Geocoding accounted for about 40% of request time in the routing API. This cache targets a 90%+ hit rate.

## Owner
Joe Smith
